say:1:1720944001:1.text: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
say:1:1720944001:1.male: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
say:1:1720944001:1.female: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!

choice_prompt:2:1720944001.text: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
choice_prompt:2:1720944001.source_cn: 侦探<male>先生</male><female>小姐</female>！大消息！绝对是千载难逢的好机会！
choice_prompt:2:1720944001.male: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!
choice_prompt:2:1720944001.female: Detective! We've got our opening! This is our chance, and we may never get another one like it!

say:3:1720944002:1.text: We've had Viscount Demit's manor under watch all day. Just now, we saw him leave with the whole family in tow!
say:3:1720944002:1.source_cn: 我们一直盯着德米特子爵的府邸，就在刚才，我们亲眼看到，...

say:4:1720944003:1.text: And that's not even the best part! We asked around, the butler's off visiting family, and the servants have been given the rest of the day off!
say:4:1720944003:1.source_cn: 没错！而且我们打听过了，他家的管家今天请假去探亲，仆人...

say:5:1720944004:1.text: Which means the manor's basically empty. If we're going in, now's our chance!
say:5:1720944004:1.source_cn: 也就是说——现在他家空无一人！这是我们潜入调查的绝佳时机啊！
say:5:1720944004:1.male: Which means the manor's basically empty. If we're going in, now's our chance!
say:5:1720944004:1.female: Which means the manor's basically empty. If we're going in, now's our chance!

say:6:1720944005:1.text: Exactly. We can't let this chance pass us by!
say:6:1720944005:1.source_cn: 是的！机不可失，时不再来！

choice_prompt:7:1720944005.text: Exactly. We can't let this chance pass us by!
choice_prompt:7:1720944005.source_cn: 是的！机不可失，时不再来！

say:8:1720944006:1.text: Yes! Our first real sneaking mission!
say:8:1720944006:1.source_cn: 好耶！执行第一次潜入调查计划！

choice:7:0:1.text: Then what are we standing around for? Let's move.
choice:7:0:1.male: Then what are we standing around for? Let's move.
choice:7:0:1.female: Then what are we standing around for? Let's move.

say:0:1720945001:0.text: You were right, sir. No servants at the gate!
say:0:1720945001:0.source_cn: 老师，门口的仆人果然不在！

say:1:1720945002:0.text: Shh. Keep your voice down! We're here to investigate, not burgle the place!
say:1:1720945002:0.source_cn: 嘘，小声点！咱们这是秘密调查，不是入室抢劫！

say:0:1720946001:0.text: Good, no one's home. Let's look around and see what we can find.
say:0:1720946001:0.source_cn: 宅邸里没有人，我们四处找找看有没有什么线索吧。

say:1:1720947001:1.text: Wait... what? The prince never drew the sword! So why is this written like it already happened?
say:1:1720947001:1.source_cn: 这……王子根本就没有拔剑啊！这上面写得怎么跟亲眼看见过一样？

say:3:1720947002:1.text: No, Haria, that's not the point. This is the real giveaway. Look at the note down here: "Get it on the front page as soon as they're back from the Hall of Ancients."
say:3:1720947002:1.source_cn: 不，赫蒂奇，你没看懂。这才是真正的大新闻……你看这行小...

say:4:1720947003:1.text: They wrote this ahead of time. It's not news! It's the story they want everyone to believe!
say:4:1720947003:1.source_cn: 这根本不是报道，而是提前准备好的宣传稿！或者说，是他们...

choice_prompt:5:1720947003.text: They wrote this ahead of time. It's not news! It's the story they want everyone to believe!
choice_prompt:5:1720947003.source_cn: 这根本不是报道，而是提前准备好的宣传稿！或者说，是他们希望发生的事实！

say:6:1720947004:1.text: So... all those stories smearing Princess Peggy were meant to...
say:6:1720947004:1.source_cn: 所以……《赛凡纳之眼》之前抹黑佩吉公主，就是为了……

say:7:1720947005:1.text: To pave the way for the prince, exactly! Bring the princess down, shove her out of the way, then stage a miracle and make it seem like the prince was fated to draw the sword. Once people believe that, the crown is as good as his!
say:7:1720947005:1.source_cn: 就是为了给王子的上位做铺垫！先把公主的名声搞臭，让她失...

say:8:1720947006:1.text: My gosh... these people are ruthless!
say:8:1720947006:1.source_cn: 天哪……贵族的世界，真是太可怕了！

choice:5:0:1.text: They're building a case for Prince Orion to take the throne.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 为奥利安王子的登基造势
choice:5:0:1.male: They're building a case for Prince Orion to take the throne.
choice:5:0:1.female: They're building a case for Prince Orion to take the throne.

choice:5:1:2.text: That's what this was all about.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 这才是他们的真实目的
choice:5:1:2.male: That's what this was all about.
choice:5:1:2.female: That's what this was all about.

say:1:1720948001:1.text: Oh, here's something good. Their pitch list!
say:1:1720948001:1.source_cn: 喔，同行的选题单，这可是行业机密啊！

say:2:1720948002:1.text: That's all they've got, really. First they drag the queen and Princess Peggy through the mud, then they turn around and sing the prince's praises in every way they can think of. No subtlety to it at all.
say:2:1720948002:1.source_cn: 不过嘛，也就这点伎俩了。先给王后和佩吉公主泼脏水，再变...

say:3:1720948003:1.text: Honestly, this line of work gets more ridiculous by the day. Ten new story pitches from every reporter? They're working them to the bone!
say:3:1720948003:1.source_cn: 说起来，干我们这行可真是越来越卷了，这同行的老板也太压...

say:5:1720948004:1.text: Come to think of it... not a single one of my pitches has ever gotten past the editor-in-chief. At this point, I'd rather make up ten stories than keep racking my brain for new ideas...
say:5:1720948004:1.source_cn: 我的选题……主编一次都没有通过。比起绞尽脑汁想新选题，...

say:6:1720948005:1.text: Haria, that's exactly the wrong lesson to take from this. When the editor-in-chief shoots down your pitches, it's meant to help you grow! If your first thought is to make things up, then you've still got a lot to learn as a reporter!
say:6:1720948005:1.source_cn: 赫蒂奇，主编否定你的选题是磨练你的新闻嗅觉，希望你能更...

say:7:1720948006:1.text: Yes, sir... though, just so you know, I may have taken a peek at your pitches... Didn't look like the editor approved many of yours either.
say:7:1720948006:1.source_cn: 好的，老师……可是，我偷偷看过，您的选题……主编好像也...

say:8:1720948007:1.text: Ahem. Let's stay on task and see if there's anything else here!
say:8:1720948007:1.source_cn: 咳咳，我们再仔细看看有没有别的线索吧，专心工作！

say:1:1720949001:1.text: Wow... this paper is spending an unbelievable amount of money every month!
say:1:1720949001:1.source_cn: 哇……他们报社，每个月居然有这么多钱可以花！

say:3:1720949002:1.text: And I'd bet a good chunk of it never ended up where it was supposed to!
say:3:1720949002:1.source_cn: 哼，花得多，进自己口袋的也不少啊。

say:4:1720949003:1.text: Look at this. Five thousand gold for "property maintenance"? What, is the roof made of gold? That's not a real expense. That's someone skimming money and not even trying very hard to hide it.
say:4:1720949003:1.source_cn: 你看这笔场地维护费，5000金币？他家屋顶是金子做的吗...

say:5:1720949004:1.text: And this part's even stranger. Why is emergency funding for public works mixed in with the newspaper's expenses?
say:5:1720949004:1.source_cn: 还有这笔市政工程紧急款……为什么会和报社的支出混在一起？

say:6:1720949005:1.text: Because Viscount Demit clearly doesn't separate the two. He's treating the paper's accounts like his own private purse. Apparently even planks and rope can cost five thousand gold if he's the one signing off on it...
say:6:1720949005:1.source_cn: 看起来德米特子爵完全把报社账户当成自己的私人账户了，购...

say:7:1720949006:1.text: Compared to that, our paper almost feels kind of charming in how broke it is...
say:7:1720949006:1.source_cn: 这样相比起来，我们报社还真是寒酸啊……

say:0:1720949501:0.text: Keep looking. There has to be more...
say:0:1720949501:0.source_cn: 再找找有没有其他线索吧……
say:0:1720949501:0.male: Keep looking. There has to be more...
say:0:1720949501:0.female: Keep looking. There has to be more...

say:1:1720950001:1.text: Good grief... this is less an employment list and more a roll call of local troublemakers!
say:1:1720950001:1.source_cn: 天哪，这、这与其说是人员雇佣名单，不如说是罪犯名单吧！

say:3:1720950002:1.text: That makes sense. A paper like this wouldn't hire real journalists. It'd hire the kind of people who know how to spread rumors, threaten people, and stir up trouble.
say:3:1720950002:1.source_cn: 哼，能写出那种新闻的，肯定不是什么正经人。德米特子爵这...

say:4:1720950003:1.text: Still... eighty gold base pay? Huh. I thought people writing stories like these would be making a lot more.
say:4:1720950003:1.source_cn: 不过……底薪80金币？啧啧啧，我还以为他们写出那种爆款...

say:5:1720950004:1.text: So they're taking that kind of risk for so little? I hate to say it, but that makes me feel a lot better about our own pay.
say:5:1720950004:1.source_cn: 搞了半天，冒着这么大的风险，就挣这点辛苦钱啊？唉，我这...

say:1:1720951001:1.text: This letter sounds shady... The tone's all careful and secretive. Sounds like they were discussing something serious.
say:1:1720951001:1.source_cn: 老师，这封信的口吻神神秘秘的……感觉他们在商讨什么了不...

say:3:1720951002:1.text: Mm... just your usual political dirty work. Start a rumor, get people talking, then once the target's on the ropes, move in and finish the job. That's pretty much how it goes.
say:3:1720951002:1.source_cn: 嗯……左不过是些政治阴谋罢了。先四处散播流言，播下怀疑...

say:4:1720951003:1.text: What about this "generous sponsor"? Could that be the one bankrolling all this?
say:4:1720951003:1.source_cn: 那信里这个“慷慨的大人”……他会不会就是那个神秘的出资人？

say:5:1720951004:1.text: Maybe. But look at the ending. "The Syndicate and our allies." This sounds bigger than one sponsor. More like a whole group betting on the next king.
say:5:1720951004:1.source_cn: 不止。你看信的结尾，提到了“商会和盟友们”……这背后，...

choice_prompt:6:1720951004.text: Maybe. But look at the ending. "The Syndicate and our allies." This sounds bigger than one sponsor. More like a whole group betting on the next king.
choice_prompt:6:1720951004.source_cn: 不止。你看信的结尾，提到了“商会和盟友们”……这背后，恐怕是一整个押注未来国王的利益集团啊。

say:7:1720951005:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate?! Yeah... that would explain a lot! They've got the kind of money it would take to fund something like this, and they've got every reason to trash the princess!
say:7:1720951005:1.source_cn: 黑金商会？！对啊，这样就全说得通了！也只有黑金商会才有...

say:8:1720951006:1.text: Exactly. They've been at odds with the Mithril Consortium for ages, and Princess Peggy is about to marry into it. So if they bring her down, they hurt the Consortium too... Makes sense.
say:8:1720951006:1.source_cn: 他们想和秘银商会对着干，所以就对与秘银有婚约的佩吉公主...

choice_prompt:9:1720951006.text: Exactly. They've been at odds with the Mithril Consortium for ages, and Princess Peggy is about to marry into it. So if they bring her down, they hurt the Consortium too... Makes sense.
choice_prompt:9:1720951006.source_cn: 他们想和秘银商会对着干，所以就对与秘银有婚约的佩吉公主出手……原来如此，一切都串起来了！

say:10:1720951007:1.text: And the letter backs that up. It says "allies," which means there's more than one major player involved...
say:10:1720951007:1.source_cn: 没错，信里还提到了“盟友们”，说明这浑水里不止一条大鱼……

say:11:1720951008:1.text: Still... for someone caught up in a conspiracy this big, Demit is an idiot. The letter literally tells him to burn it after reading, and he just leaves it lying around!
say:11:1720951008:1.source_cn: 不过话说回来，德米特子爵也真是个蠢货。人家都让他“阅后...

choice:9:0:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate may only be part of the picture.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 黑金商会可能只是其中之一
choice:9:0:1.male: The Adamant Syndicate may only be part of the picture.
choice:9:0:1.female: The Adamant Syndicate may only be part of the picture.

choice:9:1:2.text: There might be more to it than meets the eye.
choice:9:1:2.male: There might be more to it than meets the eye.
choice:9:1:2.female: There might be more to it than meets the eye.

choice:6:0:1.text: That'd be Adamant Syndicate, my longtime rival.
choice:6:0:1.male: That'd be Adamant Syndicate, my longtime rival.
choice:6:0:1.female: That'd be Adamant Syndicate, my longtime rival.

narration:0:1720953001:1.text: By the time you finish searching the whole manor, you're sure you've seen everything worth seeing...
narration:0:1720953001:1.male: By the time you finish searching the whole manor, you're sure you've seen everything worth seeing...
narration:0:1720953001:1.female: By the time you finish searching the whole manor, you're sure you've seen everything worth seeing...

say:2:1720953002:1.text: This is it! The proof's all here! Fake accounts, articles written before anything even happened, letters laying out the whole plot... If this comes to light, it'll shake the whole city!
say:2:1720953002:1.source_cn: 太棒了！罪证确凿！子爵的假账、未卜先知的报道、密谋的信...

say:4:1720953003:1.text: So we go back and write the story now, right? This is tomorrow's front page!
say:4:1720953003:1.source_cn: 老师，我们现在就回去写报道吗？明天《赛凡纳晨报》的头条...

say:5:1720953004:1.text: Not yet. The evidence is strong, but Demit is still a viscount, and he clearly has powerful people behind him. If we rush the story out now, the nobles will call it slander, and bury the whole thing before it has a chance to do any real damage.
say:5:1720953004:1.source_cn: 不……还不行。我有点担心，这些证据虽然劲爆，但德米特毕...

say:6:1720953005:1.text: At most, we'd make him look bad for a while. That's barely a slap on the wrist compared to what he's done. And if he manages to make a comeback later, there's a good chance he'll come after us!
say:6:1720953005:1.source_cn: 咱们的报道最多只能把他的名声搞臭，恐怕他不会受到什么实...

say:7:1720953006:1.text: So what do we do? We can't just stop here. We've already come this far! And as journalists, we're supposed to stand for the truth. We can't let fear of retaliation stop us... at least, that's how I see it.
say:7:1720953006:1.source_cn: 那我们该怎么办？都调查到这儿了，总不能放弃吧！作为记者...

choice_prompt:8:1720953006.text: So what do we do? We can't just stop here. We've already come this far! And as journalists, we're supposed to stand for the truth. We can't let fear of retaliation stop us... at least, that's how I see it.
choice_prompt:8:1720953006.source_cn: 那我们该怎么办？都调查到这儿了，总不能放弃吧！作为记者，我们应该伸张正义，不应该害怕报复……我是这样想的。

say:9:1720953007:1.text: That would work, in theory. But would ordinary guards go near a case that touches the nobility?
say:9:1720953007:1.source_cn: 道理是这个道理，可是普通的守备军估计不敢插手这样的事吧……

choice_prompt:10:1720953008.text: Right. So who can actually make that happen?
choice_prompt:10:1720953008.source_cn: 道理是这个道理，可是该怎么做呢？

say:11:1720953009:0.text: Commander Hendrik?! Wait... you know Commander Hendrik? If you don't mind me asking... who are you, exactly?
say:11:1720953009:0.source_cn: 亨德里克司令？！侦探<male>先生</male><f...
say:11:1720953009:0.male: Commander Hendrik?! Wait... you know Commander Hendrik? If you don't mind me asking... who are you, exactly?
say:11:1720953009:0.female: Commander Hendrik?! Wait... you know Commander Hendrik? If you don't mind me asking... who are you, exactly?

say:12:1720953010:1.text: With Commander Hendrik on this, we have nothing to worry about, right? Come on, let's get back and write the story. Savannah, get ready for a storm!
say:12:1720953010:1.source_cn: 有了亨德里克司令参与调查，我们就不用害怕了吧？老师，我...

say:13:1720953011:1.text: Then that's the plan. Detective, you get the guard moving. We'll get the story ready to run. We can't let Viscount Demit wriggle his way out of this!
say:13:1720953011:1.source_cn: 那我们双管齐下，侦探<male>先生</male><f...
say:13:1720953011:1.male: Then that's the plan. Detective, you get the guard moving. We'll get the story ready to run. We can't let Viscount Demit wriggle his way out of this!
say:13:1720953011:1.female: Then that's the plan. Detective, you get the guard moving. We'll get the story ready to run. We can't let Viscount Demit wriggle his way out of this!

choice:10:0:1.text: Commander Hendrik can. I happen to know him.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 我刚好和亨德里克司令有一些私交
choice:10:0:1.male: Commander Hendrik can. I happen to know him.
choice:10:0:1.female: Commander Hendrik can. I happen to know him.

choice:8:0:1.text: The guards need to handle the rest of this.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 这件事该由守备军来收尾
choice:8:0:1.male: The guards need to handle the rest of this.
choice:8:0:1.female: The guards need to handle the rest of this.

say:15:1720953008:1.text: Right. So who can actually make that happen?
say:15:1720953008:1.source_cn: 道理是这个道理，可是该怎么做呢？

choice:8:1:2.text: He needs to be brought to justice.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 要让他受到律法的惩罚
choice:8:1:2.male: He needs to be brought to justice.
choice:8:1:2.female: He needs to be brought to justice.

say:1:1720954001:1.text: You got here fast, Magister Merlin. What's wrong?
say:1:1720954001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您匆匆赶来，是有什么事吗？
say:1:1720954001:1.male: You got here fast, Magister Merlin. What's wrong?
say:1:1720954001:1.female: You got here fast, Magister Merlin. What's wrong?

say:2:1720954002:1.text: You tell Hendrik everything. The Savannah Eye, the lies it spreads, the investigation, and everything you found in Viscount Demit's manor.
say:2:1720954002:1.source_cn: 你将《赛凡纳之眼》的阴谋、调查过程、以及在德米特子爵府...
say:2:1720954002:1.male: You tell Hendrik everything. The Savannah Eye, the lies it spreads, the investigation, and everything you found in Viscount Demit's manor.
say:2:1720954002:1.female: You tell Hendrik everything. The Savannah Eye, the lies it spreads, the investigation, and everything you found in Viscount Demit's manor.

say:3:1720954003:1.text: The more he hears, the grimmer he looks.
say:3:1720954003:1.source_cn: 听着你的调查结果，亨德里克的面色逐渐凝重。
say:3:1720954003:1.male: The more he hears, the grimmer he looks.
say:3:1720954003:1.female: The more he hears, the grimmer he looks.

say:4:1720954004:1.text: So that's what was going on. Those rumors about the queen and the princess didn't just catch on by themselves. Someone had been spreading them on purpose from the start.
say:4:1720954004:1.source_cn: 原来如此，市井间那些针对王后与公主的流言，背后竟是如此...
say:4:1720954004:1.male: So that's what was going on. Those rumors about the queen and the princess didn't just catch on by themselves. Someone had been spreading them on purpose from the start.
say:4:1720954004:1.female: So that's what was going on. Those rumors about the queen and the princess didn't just catch on by themselves. Someone had been spreading them on purpose from the start.

say:5:1720954005:1.text: That's it. I'm sending men after Demit right now.
say:5:1720954005:1.source_cn: 我现在就下令，全力拘捕德米特子爵。
say:5:1720954005:1.male: That's it. I'm sending men after Demit right now.
say:5:1720954005:1.female: That's it. I'm sending men after Demit right now.

say:6:1720954006:1.text: You finally let yourself relax, certain the viscount's arrest is only a matter of time. But before long, the guard sent to carry out the operation returns with unexpected news—
say:6:1720954006:1.source_cn: 你放下心来，等待着子爵的落网。然而，没过多久，负责执行...
say:6:1720954006:1.male: You finally let yourself relax, certain the viscount's arrest is only a matter of time. But before long, the guard sent to carry out the operation returns with unexpected news—
say:6:1720954006:1.female: You finally let yourself relax, certain the viscount's arrest is only a matter of time. But before long, the guard sent to carry out the operation returns with unexpected news—

say:8:1720954007:1.text: Commander, we have a problem. Viscount Demit is gone!
say:8:1720954007:1.source_cn: 司令，不好！德米特子爵他……他失踪了！
say:8:1720954007:1.male: Commander, we have a problem. Viscount Demit is gone!
say:8:1720954007:1.female: Commander, we have a problem. Viscount Demit is gone!

say:0:1720962001:0.text: The dock is just ahead. Let's take a look around.
say:0:1720962001:0.source_cn: 前面就是码头，我们仔细调查一下。

say:1:1720963001:1.text: Hold it. You're not supposed to be here.
say:1:1720963001:1.source_cn: 站住，你们走错路了吧？这是你们的地盘吗？
say:1:1720963001:1.male: Hold it. You're not supposed to be here.
say:1:1720963001:1.female: Hold it. You're not supposed to be here.

say:2:1720963002:1.text: Easy there. We were just taking a walk, enjoying the lovely dockside scenery...
say:2:1720963002:1.source_cn: 哎，几位好兄弟误会了，我们就是随便逛逛，欣赏欣赏码头的...

say:3:1720963003:1.text: Then keep walking. Unless you want your face rearranged!
say:3:1720963003:1.source_cn: 风景？我劝你们还是去看看自己脸上的风景吧！识相的，就赶...

say:4:1720963004:1.text: Boss, why are we even talking to them? We were told not to let anyone near this place!

say:6:1720963005:1.text: This is guard business. Move aside now, or we'll move you ourselves.
say:6:1720963005:1.source_cn: 守备军在此办案，你们是要妨碍公务吗？

say:7:1720963006:1.text: Boss! It's the guards! What do we do?!

say:8:1720963007:1.text: Guards? Hah. Down here, your badge doesn't mean a thing. Time you learned how things work at the dock!

say:8:1720963007:1.female: Guards? Hah. Down here, your badge doesn't mean a thing. Time you learned how things work at the dock!

say:0:1720963501:0.text: Alright, alright! Search whatever you want!

say:1:1720963502:0.text: Never should've taken work from that viscount!

say:0:1720964001:0.text: Look over there! That boat... see it? It looks like it was patched up not long ago!

say:1:1720964002:0.text: The way in is blocked with junk. Let's clear it!
say:1:1720964002:0.source_cn: 通往码头的路被杂物挡住了，我们清理一下吧！

say:1:1720966001:1.text: Hendrik?! How did you find me?!

say:1:1720966001:1.male: Hendrik?! How did you find me?!
say:1:1720966001:1.female: Hendrik?! How did you find me?!

say:3:1720966002:1.text: It's over, Demit. This farce ends here.
say:3:1720966002:1.source_cn: 德米特，你的闹剧该收场了。

say:4:1720966003:1.text: Ha! You think you've won? Don't get ahead of yourselves! You're just the queen's dogs!
say:4:1720966003:1.source_cn: 闹剧？哼！你们这些王后的走狗！别得意得太早！

say:5:1720966004:1.text: Prince Orion will return. And when he takes the throne, every one of you traitors will answer for this!
say:5:1720966004:1.source_cn: 等着吧！奥利安王子一定会回来的！到时候，等他加冕为王，...

say:6:1720966005:1.source_cn: 这些话，你留着在法庭上说吧。

say:10:1720966008:1.male: You're too kind, Commander. We got the biggest story in town out of this, and we got to work with the detective while we were at it. I'd say we did alright!

Following this lead, it didn't take them long to discover an unregistered ship that departed from the old docks every midnight.

<style="stress">【德米特子爵，已招供！】</style>
本报记者马斯卡
日前在王都引起轩然大波的神秘报纸《赛凡纳之眼》，其幕后黑手——德米特子爵，已对其所有罪行供认不讳！
调查显示，这位家道中落的子爵，在得到巨额资助后，秘密创办了《赛凡纳之眼》。他招募了一批有前科的混混，系统性地捏造、散播针对佩吉公主与王后的恶意谣言，其用心之险恶，令人发指。
更令人震惊的是，在阴谋败露之际，狡猾的德米特子爵竟企图利用其负责市政管理的职权，通过水路潜逃。所幸，在有关人士的全力追捕下，他最终落网。
尽管德米特子爵已经落网，但我们有理由相信，这起阴谋的背后，还隐藏着更庞大、更黑暗的势力。本报将持续关注此案的后续进展，为所有追求真相的读者带来第一手报道！

<style="stress">【惊情赛凡纳！】</style>
<style="stress">【实习记者的心跳之旅！】</style>
作者赫蒂奇
人物介绍
菲莉帕：充满活力与好奇心的实习记者，虽然偶尔有些迷糊，但拥有敏锐的直觉和不畏艰险的勇气。为了追查少女失踪案，她意外闯入了一个充满魔法与危险的世界。
夜瞳：身份成谜的强大魔法师，性格温柔，似乎背负着沉重的过去。他被赫蒂奇的纯真与执着所打动，决定协助她调查真相。在不经意间，他总会流露出对菲莉帕的温柔与保护。
阿洛伊斯：居住在古堡中的吸血鬼贵族，也是少女失踪案的头号嫌疑人。传说他英俊、优雅，却又冷酷无情，守护着不为人知的秘密。
……
菲利帕的思绪飞速运转着，“古堡坐落于孤岛之上，没有桥梁与其他陆地相连……那么，那些失踪的少女前往古堡的唯一途径，只能是水路！”
听着她清晰的推理，夜瞳的眼神，不由得露出一丝赞许。
顺着这条线索，他们很快便查明：在旧港区码头，每逢午夜，都会有一艘未经登记的“幽灵船”悄然离港，终点不明。
夜瞳指尖轻点，微光笼罩之下，菲利帕和夜瞳一瞬间化作两只毛茸茸的小仓鼠，悄无声息地溜上了那艘神秘的船只。
船舱的阴影角落里，两只仓鼠紧紧地挤在一起取暖。夜瞳的声音从旁边传来，带着一丝笑意：“仓鼠的样子，倒也很适合你。”
夜瞳的低语将菲利帕的思绪拉回片刻，但她的心，早已飞向了那座笼罩在月色下的孤岛古堡。那位神秘的古堡主人，阿洛伊斯伯爵……他真的如传闻那般，是一个冷酷无情的恶魔吗？还是说，在那副冰冷的面具之下，另有隐情……
……

say:13:1720971010:1.text: Oh, then you definitely missed the interview. She said she gathered a lot of material while working as an intern reporter, but back then, the idea of writing a novel had never even crossed her mind.

say:14:1720971011:1.text: Then the paper slapped her with this insane sales quota. The pressure got so bad she could hardly breathe, and one night, just to get some of it out of her system, she started writing. That was how the story began!
say:14:1720971011:1.source_cn: 后来报社高层把提高报纸销量这个不可能完成的任务交给了她...

say:15:1720971012:1.text: Ahh, I'm dying to read the next chapter! Miss Haria, please update soon!
say:15:1720971012:1.source_cn: 啊——！好想看下一期！赫蒂奇小姐，快点更新啊！我已经等...

say:16:1720971013:1.text: Listening to them go on, you can't help smiling. Then you look down at Haria's name on the page.
say:16:1720971013:1.source_cn: 听着少女们热情洋溢的讨论，你无奈地笑了笑，低头看向报纸...
say:16:1720971013:1.male: Listening to them go on, you can't help smiling. Then you look down at Haria's name on the page.
say:16:1720971013:1.female: Listening to them go on, you can't help smiling. Then you look down at Haria's name on the page.

say:17:1720971014:1.text: Looks like this young intern really did save the paper, just not in the way anyone expected.
say:17:1720971014:1.source_cn: 看来，这位年轻的实习记者，真的靠自己，用一种意想不到的...
say:17:1720971014:1.male: Looks like this young intern really did save the paper, just not in the way anyone expected.
say:17:1720971014:1.female: Looks like this young intern really did save the paper, just not in the way anyone expected.

say:18:1720971015:1.text: And somewhere along the way, she seems to have found her true calling...
say:18:1720971015:1.source_cn: 而且，还在不经意间，找到了自己真正的天赋所在……

say:18:1720971015:1.female: And somewhere along the way, she seems to have found her true calling...
